title: South Caucasus Open Archaeology Initiative (SCOAI): Radiocarbon Normalization, Epigraphy, and Spatial Dataset Toolkit
description: Open-source computational archaeology toolkit and geocoded dataset (GeoJSON, Pelagios Linked Places JSON-LD, and XRONOS 14C tables) for the South Caucasus, featuring Ward & Wilson (1978) chi-squared chronometric verification, stratigraphic superposition self-correction workflows, IntCal20 calibration, Asomtavruli/Nuskhuri epigraphic transliteration, and the CaucasusArch-Bench evaluation suite.

creators.name: Ker, Willi
creators.affiliation: South Caucasus Open Archaeology Initiative (Tbilisi, Georgia)
